description: Generate a chat response for a list of messages using a local model.

messages.description: The non-empty list of chat messages (each with a role and content) to send to the model.

content.description: The text content of this chat message.

role.description: The role of this chat message (e.g. 'user', 'assistant', or 'system').

model.description: The name of the local model to generate the chat response with.

name: chat_completion
